summary: Full-stack testing of Super Strike bowling game. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASS covering players, scores, leaderboard (sorted desc, no _id leaked), player stats aggregation, and complete multiplayer rooms flow (create, join, get, progress -> finished + winner/tie, 404 on missing room, 400 on 3rd player join, idempotent re-join). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Home renders with all mode buttons and nav testIDs; Solo Play completes a full 10-frame game via LOCK AIM -> THROW loop, routes to Results (FINAL SCORE 71, home/play-again buttons present) and score is submitted (verified on Leaderboard screen showing sorted rows). Vs CPU flow entered game, player throws work, 'CPU is bowling...' status observed, both YOU/CPU scores update on the top HUD. Multiplayer 'Create Room' displays a 4-char code (A52G) with 'Waiting for opponent...' and 'Bowler3260 (you) HOST'. Leaderboard screen loads sorted list (275, 200, 150, 100, 71). Profile screen loads stats grid (Games/Best/Average/Strikes/Wins) and name save shows 'Saved!' feedback. No red-screen errors. Minor deprecation warnings: React Native Web 'shadow*'/'textShadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (non-blocking web warnings from RN core, not app code). Font Fredoka.ttf fails to decode on web (OTS parsing error) but text still renders with fallback font.

issues: Custom font 'Fredoka.ttf' fails to decode on web preview ('OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion: 168430090'). Fallback font is used so text renders, but the intended bold display look is missing on web. File may be an LFS pointer/corrupted asset in /app/frontend/assets/fonts/Fredoka.ttf.

React Native Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use textShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated. These come from the app's theme/shadow tokens and animation code; not functional bugs but should be modernized.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace assets/fonts/Fredoka.ttf with a valid TTF (current file appears corrupted / not a real font, causing OTS decode errors on web).
OPTIONAL: Migrate deprecated RN Web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, textShadow* -> textShadow, and prop pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents.
None of the above blocks any user flow; MVP is fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via clean() helper on all responses (verified none leak).
Backend uses env vars for MONGO_URL / DB_NAME (no defaults). Good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API base (no hardcoding). Good.

All interactive elements have testID (mode-solo/cpu/multiplayer, lock-aim, throw, scorecard, quit-game, create-room, room-code-input, join-room, room-code-display, name-input, save-name, leaderboard-list, home/play-again).
Multiplayer join is idempotent for the same player_id (verified via test).

One minor gotcha in game.tsx: postProgress uses meRef.current.done inside its handler, which relies on the ref being updated synchronously by applyThrow before postProgress fires - this is correct because applyThrow runs synchronously prior to the setTimeout postProgress. No fix needed.
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_* prefixed players and scores. Leaderboard now contains TEST_LB_User (275), TEST_Stats_Agg (200/150/100), TEST_Host, TEST_Guest, TEST_T1/T2, TEST_F1/2/3, TEST_Rejoin, TEST_NF plus the two Bowler#### players auto-created via the UI (Bowler8318 solo 71, Bowler3260 as multiplayer host, Bowler3324 profile). Optional: main agent may clean TEST_* documents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 12 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_super_strike_api.py are green. Solo game auto-loop: click [data-testid=lock-aim-button] -> [data-testid=throw-button] and wait ~1.5s; ~40 iterations completes 10 frames. Vs CPU takes longer because each CPU turn adds ~2-3s; use >90 iterations if you need to reach Results. Multiplayer live 2-user play was validated only at API level (backend tests) + lobby UI; single-browser live match not exercised (out of scope per the request). Fonts failing to decode is a Fredoka.ttf asset issue, not a code bug.
